digest: Claim verified: MDN BCD records Firefox AbortSignal.timeout() support from version 100, corroborated by Firefox 100 release notes.
verdictDigest: Firefox support is exactly version_added 100 in MDN BCD and is independently announced in Firefox 100 release notes. Sources: BCD and MDN Firefox 100. Caveat: this verifies Firefox only.

evidence.relevance: The timeout_static compatibility entry lists Firefox support as version 100.

evidence.quote: Code can now use the static method `AbortSignal.timeout()`.
evidence.relevance: Firefox 100 release notes explicitly announce AbortSignal.timeout() support.

caveats: The evidence verifies Firefox 100 support, not all browsers or Node.js.
